label: GO after unrewarded a2, largest after rare a2->S1, grows with S2 belief and episode time
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.clip(-belief_lo,-5,5) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.clip(-belief_lo,-5,5) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Fires only at GO. Magnitude is set by the previous trial: near zero unless the last trial was a2 and unrewarded. It is largest after a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded (residual about +0.16), smaller after a2 -> S2 (common) unrewarded (about +0.05), and slightly negative after all other patterns. Inside those cells it grows with the ideal-observer belief that S2 is good (-belief_lo) and with episode time (ep_dec); the ep_dec slope is steeper after the rare pattern. It is suppressed when the trial before was also unrewarded (two losses in a row). With the 2 previous-trial indicators alone, dev R^2 beyond timing is 0.25. Adding belief and ep_dec gives 0.37, and adding the two-loss and GO-offset terms gives dev 0.42 and test 0.42. That is above the profile all ceiling (0.35) and all-observed (0.32), because these terms are interactions. It uses no model outputs and no future variables. Unexplained: wide variation in amplitude (0.07 to 0.7) for the same pattern across windows.
